comparison.objective: Pick a training lock using tension and pin setting; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual maintenance of plug torque while probing binding pins versus body stabilization, hex-key engagement, collar rotation, setscrew locking, and cycle-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: All pins set, plug turned to open, and tools withdrawn versus two repeatable safe stops and collar drift below tolerance. Exact lock-force thresholds and separate spec versions were not provided.
comparison.reason: There is notable shared bimanual fine-tool and force-control structure, but lock-state discovery and damper calibration are meaningfully different tested abilities.
